title: Video generation gets a clearer front door
summary:
Video generation became easier to use, search and tier UI got clearer, and the community and infrastructure paths received a careful tune-up.

Chat.Pollinations.AI now includes video generation and a newcomer tutorial, while the Video API received fixes for image-to-video models, duration handling, and its OpenAPI documentation. Making pixels move is easy; making the parameters agree on how long they should move took a little gardening.

Perplexity and Gemini Search models now carry a web-search icon, and the tier interface adds an explanation panel with styling refinements so people can better understand what they are looking at before clicking around.

A new AI-powered workflow reviews project submissions, alongside voting-status diagram tooling and Discord configuration to give community processes a more visible path from contribution to decision.
